messages:
Mia: kickoff: want a compact benchmark story for the launch that product teams can grok in <60s. focus: real traces, clear tradeoffs between latency, throughput, and per-request spend. need 3 visuals + one short interactive + inbound routing plan.

Raj: +1. propose: Visual A: Throughput vs Unit Spend (showing hosted vs dedicated vs private). Visual B: Cost Reduction Waterfall (what batching/caching/quantization buys you). Visual C: Failure & Degradation Path (how routing + fallbacks preserve SLOs).

Claire: visual specs: A: x=throughput (req/s), y=cost per 1k tokens (log), overlay p50/p95 latency contours. annotate a few customer archetypes (chat bot, reranker, summarizer). B: stacked bars showing baseline -> savings steps -> realized cost. C: simple swimlane: request -> primary -> fallback -> degrade gracefully. add % cost delta labels.

Mia: wording for hero experiments: economy-first: "Cut per-request spend without sacrificing latency" latency-first: "Consistent latency under real load". both should lead to the intake prompt.

Frank: webinar idea (25 min): 1) 6-min chart walk (real traces), 2) 8-min config demo (batching + cache slider), 3) 6-min case vignette + Q&A. lightweight demo app: change token mix slider and show waterfall update.

Jules: inbound mapping (growth): form fields: workload (chat/summarize/rank/embed), latency sensitivity (low/med/high), compliance (yes/no), size (pilot/prod). routing: high-latency-sens -> SDR+dedicated trial; compliance=yes -> AE + private eval; pilot -> hosted credits. tag leads with recommended visual slice.

Raj: interactive wire: single slider for token mix (prompt/context/gen), second optional: cache-hit-rate slider. update waterfall numbers live and highlight which chart region the user sits in. easy to prototype in figma + a small react widget.

Claire: tiny design notes: keep axis labels two words max, use colorblind-safe palette, tooltip must show p50/p95 and cost delta. for waterfall, show absolute $ and % savings.

Mia: copy variants for landing: A) "Compare your workload to production traces 9 See latency and per-request cost tradeoffs in 2 minutes." CTA: "Compare my workload" B) "Real workloads, real economics. Find the config that fits your SLO." CTA: "Start a free evaluation"

Devbot: uploaded perf artifacts: https://redwood-internal/benchmarks/2026-03-pack.zip (contains per-route p50/p95, quant levels, batching sims).

Jules: routing ops notes: add lead tags: "latency-focused", "cost-focused", "compliance" so SDR/AEs get context. also add UTM param mapping for AB hero test.

Frank: will draft the 3-demo scripts and screencast checklist. aim to record 10-min highlight for social.

Mia: action list: Claire -> figma frames + two hero variants (due Thu). Raj -> slider prototype + intake form wire (due Mon). Jules -> routing mapping doc and UTMs (due Fri). Frank -> webinar script + highlight clip (due Tue). I will write the landing copy and 2 subject lines for the email invite.

Claire: on it. will ping when frames are in figma. :white_check_mark:

Raj: prototyping the widget today, will share an embedable react snippet.

Mia: thanks team. want this to feel tactical and testable. we'll A/B hero framing and measure CTR -> intake completion -> trial conversion. closing thread, will repost deck link when ready. :rocket:
